papers.title: A comparison of Ti-6Al-4V in-situ alloying in Selective Laser Melting using simply-mixed and satellited powder blend feedstocks
papers.first_author_affiliation: Centre for Additive Manufacturing, Faculty of Engineering, University of Nottingham, NG 7 2RD, UK

corresponding_authors.name: Marco Simonelli
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Additive Manufacturing, Faculty of Engineering, University of Nottingham, NG 7 2RD, UK

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-6Al-4V的SLM原位合金化工艺，与生物医学植入物增材制造相关，但未直接评估植入物性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific outcomes such as stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; it focuses on powder feedstock effects on alloying.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同混合粉末原料在SLM中对Ti-6Al-4V合金化效果的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用简单混合和卫星混合两种粉末进料方式，进行SLM成型并表征。
summary_zh.result: 卫星混合粉末改善了合金均匀性和机械性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构分析和力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of different powder blend feedstocks on in-situ alloying of Ti-6Al-4V during Selective Laser Melting.
summary_en.method: Two feedstock preparation methods, simply-mixed and satellited powder blends, were used for SLM fabrication, followed by microstructural and mechanical characterization.
summary_en.result: The satellited powder blend resulted in more homogeneous alloy composition and improved mechanical properties compared to the simply-mixed blend.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural analysis (SEM/EDS) and mechanical testing (tensile and hardness).

papers.title: Selective laser melting of 24CrNiMo steel for brake disc: Fabrication efficiency, microstructure evolution, and properties
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory for Anisotropy and Texture of Materials, Ministry of Education, Key Laboratory for Laser Application Technology and Equipment of Liaoning Province, School of Materials and Engineering, Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, Liaoning, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xueting Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory for Anisotropy and Texture of Materials, Ministry of Education, Key Laboratory for Laser Application Technology and Equipment of Liaoning Province, School of Materials and Engineering, Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, Liaoning, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及刹车盘用钢的SLM工艺，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on SLM of steel for brake discs, with no biomedical implant context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing for implants, and no osseointegration or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对刹车盘用24CrNiMo钢的成形效率和性能影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备24CrNiMo钢样品，分析工艺参数对致密度、微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 优化工艺参数获得了高致密度和良好综合力学性能的SLM成形钢。
summary_zh.validation: 通过致密度测量、显微组织观察和拉伸/硬度测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: The study investigates the effects of selective laser melting parameters on fabrication efficiency, microstructure evolution, and properties of 24CrNiMo steel for brake disc applications.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM with varying laser power and scanning speed, and characterized for densification, microstructure (SEM, EBSD), and mechanical properties (hardness, tensile).
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters led to high relative density (>99%) and improved tensile strength and hardness due to refined martensitic microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Validation through relative density measurement, microstructural observation, and mechanical testing including tensile and hardness tests.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与AM生物医学材料方向不相关，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on TiAl intermetallic composites for high-temperature applications, with no porous structures, mechanical testing for stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, osseointegration, or any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高TiAl合金的硬度与微观结构
summary_zh.method: 选区激光熔化制备TiAl/RGO复合材料
summary_zh.result: 微观组织细化和纳米硬度增强

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the nanohardness and refine the microstructure of TiAl alloys.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting (SLM) was used to fabricate TiAl composites reinforced with reduced graphene oxide (RGO).
summary_en.result: The composite exhibited refined grain size and significantly improved nanohardness compared to unreinforced TiAl.
summary_en.validation: Nanohardness measurements via nanoindentation confirmed the mechanical enhancement.
